title: Static site: per-dimension boards, overall mean-rank board, not-detected lists

comments.author: home
comments.text:
Feature: The static site renders per-dimension and overall boards

Scenario: Not-detected dimensions appear in their own list
  Given scored cells committed under studies/ for every engine and dimension
  When the static site build runs
  Then it renders a board per dimension, an overall mean-rank board across dimensions, and a not-detected list for dimensions with no significant shift, all matching studies/ byte for byte

right_now_summary: The static site now renders per-dimension boards, an overall mean-rank board, and not-detected lists.
